post.text: 🚨🗣️ 𝗡𝗘𝗪: Anmar Al Haili: "It's true that I contacted Lionel Messi before when he was at PSG. I offered him €1.4 billion per year, he refused." https://t.co/xdy2qenJQ4

description.description: A split image showing a man in traditional Saudi attire with a red and white checkered keffiyeh on the left, and a edited photo of Lionel Messi wearing an Al-Ittihad football jersey with yellow and black vertical stripes on the right.
